title: Is organic farming better for the environment than conventional farming?
summary: Our World in Data review of meta-analyses: organic wins on ecotoxicity and per-hectare impacts but uses far more land and is no better per kilogram on climate or water pollution.

assertions.quote: the research is far more mixed
Organic farming tends to get lower yields and therefore uses more land.
organic farming almost always uses more land
Studies typically find greater diversity of plant, insect, and bird species on organic land.
This doesn’t mean organic farming is chemical or pesticide-free.
organic farming almost always had much lower ecotoxicity than conventional farming

verdicts.note: Life-cycle meta-analyses find lower ecotoxicity for organic in nearly all comparisons, with copper-based fungicides the main exception.
The LCA meta-analysis explicitly could not assess ecotoxicity, human health or biodiversity because too few LCAs reported them.

assertions.quote: there was no statistically significant difference between organic and conventional farming when it came to greenhouse gas emissions

verdicts.note: Meta-analyses find no consistent per-kilogram emissions difference; lower per-hectare emissions are offset by lower yields.

assertions.quote: What you eat, and all of these location and farm-specific factors, matter much more than whether it’s organic or not.

verdicts.note: Emissions differ many-fold between foods such as beef and legumes, dwarfing organic versus conventional differences.

Differences between foods dwarf differences between production systems: ruminant meat has 20-100 times the impacts of plant foods on every indicator, whereas organic vs conventional differs by tens of percent and not at all on GHG.

assertions.quote: An organic world wouldn’t just mean more farmland. It would also lack the nitrogen needed to feed the 8 or 9 billion people in it.

verdicts.note: Modelling studies find a fully organic system needs much more land and faces nitrogen shortfalls unless diets shift and food waste falls.

assertions.quote: antibiotics cannot be used throughout their lifetime, except in emergency cases
